title: Concept: Adonis exception code in a response
description: An Adonis error code such as E_ROW_NOT_FOUND in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The code identifies the framework and the exact failure class, which is enough to distinguish a missing row from a validation problem while probing identifiers.
applicability: Deployments that render an Adonis error code such as E_ROW_NOT_FOUND into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The code identifies the framework and the exact failure class, which is enough to distinguish a missing row from a validation problem while probing identifiers.
